abstract: Production skill for Google's Nano Banana image generation and editing, pinned to Gemini Nano Banana 2.1. Turns natural-language image requests into scene prompts with suitable ratio, size and thinking settings, verifies every output, and documents live-measured behaviour from 2026-10-18: 512 to 4K sizes, JPEG-only output, thinking cost and latency, search grounding that works only on generateContent, edit fidelity, reference limits, and known failure modes with deterministic fixes.
